name: io.github.walma-labs/shopify-mcp
description: Read-only Shopify Admin MCP server for one store: shop, products, orders, ShopifyQL analytics and any read query.

environmentVariables.name: SHOPIFY_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID of a Dev Dashboard app installed on the store (with SHOPIFY_CLIENT_SECRET)

environmentVariables.name: SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Admin API access token of a custom app created in the store admin (alternative to the client credentials)
